title: Apartment Search
searchIntent: grok bot to find an apartment
intro: Flat hunting is the job people describe first when asked what they would want an agent for, and it is easy to see why: the listings move fast, the good ones go in hours, and the work is refreshing the same four sites at the same four times a day. A bot that watched continuously and told you the moment something matched your actual criteria would be worth real money. The public catalogues do not have one. What is there are general browsing templates you could point at a property site, which will happily summarise listings you already found but will not sit and watch. The reason is probably not lack of interest — the property portals are hostile to automated access, and a bot that gets blocked on day two is worse than useless. That makes this an unusually hard open job rather than a neglected one, but it is open all the same.
